lawTitle.title: Law title keyword (法令名)
lawTitle.description: Part of a law title, e.g. 消費税法, 電子帳簿, 労働基準法. Leave empty if you give lawIds.

lawIds.title: Law IDs (法令ID)
lawIds.description: Exact e-Gov law IDs, e.g. 363AC0000000108 (消費税法). Used instead of a title search.

articles.title: Articles to fetch (条番号)
articles.description: Article numbers to fetch for each matched law. Use 30 for 第30条, 57_4 for 第57条の4. Leave empty to return law metadata only.

maxLaws.title: Max laws
maxLaws.description: Maximum number of laws to return from the title search.
